title: Persona eval package frontmatter (evals/personas/<id>.md)
description: A persona IS a test case (D9): profile for the persona-bot, fixture-generation parameters for synthetic bank exports, and expected outcomes the harness must produce. The markdown body is the persona's first-person story, used as the bot's voice.

dialect.description: Export dialect preset: eu_csv = UTF-8 ; decimal-comma; hu_csv = Windows-1250 Hungarian headers; simple_xlsx = plain XLSX sheet; revolut_csv/wise_csv/monzo_csv/n26_csv/otp_xlsx = real-bank shapes from the roadmap-B5 survey (synthetic data, authentic layout).

amount.description: [min, max] per payment; equal values = fixed salary.

days.description: Days of month payments arrive; two entries can model two earners. For irregular income, months may randomly skip some of these days.

account.description: Account id the spend appears on.

internal_transfers.description: refill_after_spend = envelope-style pairs (out of checking, into credit card) following card spending; monthly_allocation = one bulk pair after salary.

quirks.description: Behavioral traits for the persona-bot and coaching evals (e.g. forgets_subscriptions, abandons_tracking_after_3_weeks). Not used for data generation.

end_month.description: Last generated month; fixed for determinism. Default 2026-06.

seed.description: Override the RNG seed (default: derived from persona id).

desc_entropy.description: Append a unique numeric reference to every transaction description (real banks put entropy in the booking-info field; detection must group by counterparty or digit-stripped description).

sub_accounts.description: Own sub-account names receiving one-legged transfers from checking (the counterpart leg lives in an export that is never provided — the real-world CelBetet shape). Legs carry a stable OWN ACCOUNT counterparty and an entropy-laden description.

savings_sweep.description: Sweep most of each month's checking surplus to an own savings sub-account (one-legged), keeping balances realistic.

expect.description: What the harness MUST get right for this persona — consumed by the eval runner (Step 3).

onboarding_detects.description: Facts onboarding must discover, e.g. salary_days, yearly item ids, refills_not_income.

adopts_envelope.description: Category adopted during the simulated journey.

by_month.description: Simulated month index by which adoption should be proposed.

invariants.description: Named invariant checks that must hold, e.g. no_double_count, reconciliation_balances.
